subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics and its support data: wheel surface contact resolution, suspension setup parsing, vehicle/name list construction from the global vehicle array, vehicle configuration validation, physics integration stepping, suspension snapshotting, wheel dynamics initialization, and 3D matrix transforms.

summary: DERIVED architecture for the vehicle_physics scope from 13 validated functions. One main VehiclePhysicsBody object (DERIVED) carries the per-frame physics: 0x00439210 initializer, 0x0043E230 wheel-dynamics init, 0x00441450 suspension-dataset copy, and 0x00441650 RK2 integration driver. A separate SuspensionPhysicsSnapshot (DERIVED) snapshots per-frame suspension state, RelativeSpeedCalculator (DERIVED) computes AI target relative speed, and Matrix3x3 (GUESS) provides the row-major double-matrix vector transform. The remaining functions sit on unproven objects (GUESS): WheelSurfaceResolver, GearShiftController, VehicleConfigValidator, SuspensionSetup, and VehicleListContainer. Two shared global data services (GlobalVehicleArray, PhysicsParseBuffer) and a spatial query structure (dword_5EA2C0) are consumed across classes. All owners, field names and enums are worker proposals; none are packet-confirmed.

function_roles.role: Resolves per-wheel surface contact hits against a spatial nearest-neighbor structure (dword_5EA2C0) and computes a grip scale for the wheel array; runs two query passes per wheel (primary plane test, secondary signed-plane bound test).
evidence_refs: guard:0 - if the wheel count at this+0x130 is <= 0, skip the spatial-resolution loop entirely.
guard:1 - if the wheel count at this+0x130 is > 0, enter the first per-wheel loop.
guard:1 - if the wheel count at this+0x130 is > 0, enter the second per-wheel loop.

function_roles.role: Rebuilds the vehicle list container from the global vehicle array (dword_8AC390 count, dword_8AC394 base, stride 1060), destroying existing nodes and appending one 176-byte entry per vehicle.
Builds a deduplicated vehicle-name commentary list from the global vehicle array (dword_8AC390/dword_8AC394, stride 1060), clearing and rebuilding the commentary sub-list at this+0x10..0x1C.

Computes signed longitudinal (dot-product) or lateral (2D cross-product) relative speed against a target vehicle for AI steering; stores magnitudes in this+0x24 and a normalized relative speed in this+0x30.
evidence_refs: field:this:0x00000000 is a pointer to the target object whose obj+0x34E0..0x3500 fields are read; the object type is not named.

function_roles.role: Per-frame AI gear-shift control: blocks shifts while the shift timer is positive, forces reverse gear in driverStatus==6 state and neutral in carConditions==2 pit mode, and upshifts on RPM threshold with a 0.8 traction guard, capped at max gear.

Validates a vehicle configuration by parsing the default and override SVM/HDV files into byte_7C56C0; returns 0 only when both parses succeed and commits the override path into this+0/this+8 string slots when the commit flag is set.

Parses a suspension setup configuration section: reads head mass/inertia, min/max position and orientation (deg-to-rad), grows the spring array (this+0x94 capacity, this+0x98 count, this+0x9C pointer) and classifies each spring sliding/normal/free-damping (0/1/2).
Pure 3D vector transform by a row-major 3x3 double matrix: computes the difference vector (a3 - a2), applies rows this[0..8], writes the result into a4 and returns a4.

Per-frame physics initializer on the vehicle body: loads per-corner suspension setup, computes ride-height/weight-distribution/center-of-mass, builds body-coupling transforms and corner force structures, selects tire compound, runs steering geometry and per-element update passes; called each frame from TireModelInit.

Per-frame suspension physics snapshot copy: copies two collision-geometry blocks from a3, evaluates quadratic-spring/force/torque terms from the descriptor a2, then copies force/torque parameters, wheel/damper blocks and quad/spring-damper results into the snapshot struct.

Wheel dynamics initialization: pushes contact constraints, parameters and a 3-slot physics grid for 4 wheels into the global setter buffer, tears down resources, zeroes the whole object (0x1F38 bytes) and fills 4 strided wheel-struct blocks (1124-byte stride, wheel 0 at this+0x5D8) with a default pattern.

Copies four suspension datasets into the physics engine via SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine; wheels 0/1 use their own suspension pointers, the remaining two branch on a shared suspension-ID selector at this[1287].

Per-frame physics integration driver: saves/restores the FPU control word, runs the main physics update, executes a sub-stepped (RK2 midpoint) integration loop over the accumulated timestep, accumulates wheel forces, detects collision damage/DNF, and transforms inertia tensors for four wheel-link sub-objects.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsBody
classes.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics object: initializes mass/center-of-mass/suspension, integrates motion with RK2 sub-steps, accumulates wheel forces, transforms inertia tensors into world space, initializes wheel dynamics and copies suspension datasets into the physics engine.

classes.name: WheelSurfaceResolver
classes.responsibility: Per-wheel surface collision pass: queries the spatial nearest-neighbor structure for the wheel array and computes a grip scale and per-element contact pointers/heights.

classes.name: VehicleListContainer
classes.responsibility: Holds two linked lists rebuilt from the global vehicle array: the vehicle list (this+0x0..0xC, 12-byte nodes wrapping 176-byte entries) and the deduplicated commentary name list (this+0x10..0x1C, nodes wrapping 172-byte entries).

classes.name: RelativeSpeedCalculator
classes.responsibility: Computes signed relative speed between the owning AI object and a target vehicle: longitudinal closing speed via dot product or lateral speed via 2D cross product, with a normalized longitudinal speed.

classes.name: GearShiftController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame AI gear-shift control over vehicle state fields: shift-timer block, reverse/pit-mode force requests, RPM-threshold upshift with traction guard and max-gear cap.

classes.name: VehicleConfigValidator
classes.responsibility: Validates a vehicle configuration file by parsing the default and override SVM/HDV files and optionally committing the override path into the object's string slots.

classes.name: SuspensionSetup
classes.responsibility: Parsed suspension setup: setup index, body anchor and rotation reference, min/max position and orientation, and a growing spring array (capacity/count/pointer) of 100-byte classified spring entries.

classes.name: Matrix3x3
classes.responsibility: Row-major 3x3 double matrix used as a linear-algebra transform; F_3DVectorTransformBy33Matrix multiplies a difference vector by this matrix and writes the result to the output vector.

classes.name: SuspensionPhysicsSnapshot
classes.responsibility: Per-frame snapshot of suspension physics state: copies collision-geometry blocks, wheel/damper and force/torque blocks from the source physics object, evaluates quadratic-spring/force/torque terms from a parameter descriptor, and mirrors selected results.

state_machines.name: GearShiftControl
transitions: Default -> BlockedByTimer when shift_timer(this+0x3A10) > 0 (flt_59E440 zero threshold)
Default -> UpshiftReady when engine_rpm(this+0x39A0) > shift_rpm_threshold(this+0x3A18) and traction(this+0x37CC, this+0x38C4) > 0.8 and current_gear(this+0x39FC) < max_gear(this+0x3A04)
Default -> DownshiftTail via JUMPOUT(0x4F62E6) when current_gear(this+0x39FC) > 1

state_machines.name: SurfaceContactResolution
transitions: PrimaryQuery -> ContactAccepted when element+300 >= this+0x10 and nearest-neighbor hit (flag 1) found, storing hit pointer at element+276 and contact height at element+24
PrimaryQuery -> SecondaryPlaneTest when element+300 == 1 and element+276 still null
SecondaryPlaneTest -> ContactCleared when |signed plane distance| outside hit+0x84/+0x80 bounds (element+276 = 0, element+296 = -1)
SecondaryPlaneTest -> ContactAccepted when within bounds, copying element+296 from the hit chain

interfaces.name: GlobalVehicleArray
interfaces.purpose: Shared global vehicle array (dword_8AC390 count, dword_8AC394 base, stride 1060) consumed by the vehicle-list and name-list builders and by configuration validation to index vehicle entries.

interfaces.name: PhysicsParseBuffer
interfaces.purpose: Global session parse buffer byte_7C56C0 used both as the target of SVM/HDV vehicle-file parsing and as the global setter buffer for wheel-dynamics parameter pushes.

interfaces.name: SpatialNearestNeighborQuery
interfaces.purpose: Spatial structure (dword_5EA2C0) backing wheel-surface contact resolution via SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelSurfaceContactResolution
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame wheel contact pass must preserve the grip-scale formula 1.0 - (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC)*0.5 stored at this+0x170, the wheel array stride of 316 bytes with count at this+0x130 and base this+0x134, the two nearest-neighbor queries (flag 1 primary, flag 0 secondary signed-plane bound test) on dword_5EA2C0, and the phase-flag reset this+0x174 = -1 at exit.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsIntegrationGates
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame physics integration must early-out when the physics-override double at 0x005D6D70 equals 1.0 or the enable byte at 0x007CE254 is zero, must save and restore the FPU control word, and must preserve the RK2 midpoint sub-stepping (half-step wheel-data copies, accumulator this+0x60) over the timestep field this+0x68.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleFileValidation
compatibility_contracts.description: ValidateVehicleConfigurationFile returns 0 only when both the default and override SVM/HDV parses succeed; on success the parse buffer byte_7C56C0 is cleared, the cost-display mode backup dword_7C56C4 = dword_7D0450 is taken before parsing, and when the commit flag is set the override path is copied into the caller's this+0 / this+8 string slots via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and sub_568B00.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Consumers of the global vehicle array (dword_8AC390 count, dword_8AC394 base, stride 1060) rely on the driver-name byte at entry+124 and the driver-file path at entry+188; a replacement must preserve those field offsets and the array stride.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionSetupSection
compatibility_contracts.description: SuspensionSetupSectionReader must keep the degree-to-radian conversion factor 0.0174532925199433 for orientation fields, the spring-array growth rule (capacity +3 slots of 100 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper with per-slot category init), and the spring classification enums sliding/normal/free-damping (0/1/2).
